title: Senedd Cymru electoral regions, December 2022 (Wales, generalised, clipped)
description: The five regions that return the Welsh Parliament's additional member seats.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "Senedd_Cymru_Electoral_Regions_December_2022_WA_BGC" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/Senedd_Cymru_Electoral_Regions_December_2022_WA_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 5 features in WGS84.
